column1: Luis Arraez stands out as the top pick, leading off for San Diego with a strong track record of consistency and a favorable platoon edge against Walker Buehler. Arraez has hit safely in over three-quarters of his games and enters with a recent uptick in hits, making him a reliable option. Jacob Wilson also offers steady production atop Oakland’s lineup and benefits from a hitter-friendly park. CJ Abrams, Ozzie Albies, and James Wood all have platoon advantages but carry less consistent hit rates.
